title: The Lumenreed Keys: Brill Quay Lantern Ferry Queue
tests: World-only catalog entry; generated image verified at exact CLI output path; JSON parse verification pending.
prompt:

Preserve the weekly world canon: low tidal keys, shallow jade channels, lantern-ferry transit, shell-stone and woven reed materials, practical coastal island life, sea-glass green and warm brass palette, and luminous canal motifs. Avoid skyscrapers, cars, aircraft, neon cyberpunk, generic medieval fantasy, hostile monsters, logos, watermarks, and readable text.

Reusable template: Create a finished daily-life image or reusable visual artifact set in [WORLD_NAME], showing [EVERYDAY SCENE] in [SETTLEMENT OR LOCATION], with [TRANSIT OR INFRASTRUCTURE], [LOCAL MATERIALS], [VEGETATION], [LIFE FORMS], and [TIME_OF_DAY] lighting. Preserve the world geography, settlements, transit logic, vegetation, materials, palette, recurring motifs, and mood; adapt [VIEWPOINT] and [MOOD] while staying inside the canon.

Source photo needed: none.

What to preserve: The Lumenreed Keys world name, low mangrove-like keys, jade canals, Brill Quay, hand-cranked lantern ferries, shell-stone masonry, woven reed panels, brass hand gears, sea-glass windows, oilcloth awnings, lumenreeds, pearl moss, lamp crabs, glasswing moths, sea-glass green and honey-gold palette, and practical daily-life tone.

What to change: the exact daily-life subject, viewpoint, time of day, weather, settlement, transit stop, crowd activity, props, and layout can be swapped while keeping the same world bible.

Example substitution: [EVERYDAY SCENE] = neighbors stocking a storm-shelter pantry; [SETTLEMENT OR LOCATION] = Highbasin; [TRANSIT OR INFRASTRUCTURE] = rain cistern filters and ropewalk docks; [TIME_OF_DAY] = humid evening after rain; [MOOD] = calm and prepared.
